attchmntText: Petronet LNG Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates. Intimation regarding Schedule of Analyst/ Institutional Investor Meets/ Conferences pursuant to Regulation 30 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
voiceSummary: Petronet LNG Limited has intimated the schedule of analyst and institutional investor meetings pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The company will attend the JM Financial Annual India Conference 2026 on 17.11.2026 in Mumbai. This will be a one-to-one or group meeting. The company will also attend the CLSA Conference 29th India Forum on 18.11.2026 in Mumbai. This will also be a one-to-one or group meeting. Petronet LNG Limited confirmed that no unpublished price sensitive information is proposed to be shared during these conferences. The intimation was issued on 12th November 2026 by Rajan Kapur, GGM and President Company Secretary.

attchmntText: Communication to shareholders regarding deduction of tax at source (TDS) onInterim dividend for the financial year 2026-27.
voiceSummary: Petronet LNG Limited has declared an interim dividend of Rs. 7 per share for the financial year 2026-27. The Board of Directors approved this dividend in its meeting held on 2nd November 2026. Payment will be made within 30 days from the declaration date. The record date for determining eligible shareholders is 6th November 2026. The company will deduct tax at source on the dividend payment in accordance with the Income Tax Act, 2025. Resident individual shareholders are exempt from TDS if their total dividend income does not exceed Rs. 10,000. Other resident shareholders and non-resident shareholders are subject to TDS at prescribed rates. Shareholders must update their bank details and PAN with their depository participant or registrar. Documents for claiming lower or nil TDS must be submitted by 11:59 PM on 16th November 2026.

attchmntText: Petronet LNG Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Petronet LNG Limited filed a transcript of the post-results conference call held on 3rd November 2026 regarding the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended 30th September 2026. The company reported processing 231 TBTU of LNG in the quarter, with Profit Before Tax at INR1,659 crores and Profit After Tax at INR1,235 crores. For the first half, PBT was INR3,174 crores and PAT was INR2,368 crores. Management stated total capital expenditure for the first half was INR1,626 crores. The company noted that three LNG vessels are under suspended time charter agreements due to force majeure related to Qatar volumes.

Petronet LNG Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates - Closure of trading window. Pursuant to Regulation 29(2) of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, this is to inform that the Meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company will be held on Monday, 2nd November 2026, inter-alia, to consider and approve unaudited financial results of the Company for the quarter and half-year ended 30th September 2026.Pursuant to Code for Prevention of Insider Trading in the Securities of Petronet LNG Limited (PLL's Code) as well as Circular issued by the Stock Exchanges dated 2nd April, 2019, it was informed to the Stock Exchanges where the shares of the Company are listed vide letter dated 19th June 2026 that the Trading Window for dealing in securities of PLL would be closed, for all 'Insiders' as per PLL's Code, from 1st October 2026 till 48 hours after the financial results for the quarter and half-year ended 30th September 2026 would become generally available to Public.In view of the above, the Trading Window for trading in PLL's securities which was closed from 1st October 2026 shall remain closed till 4th November 2026 (both days inclusive). All Insiders are advised not to deal with the securities of PLL during this period.
